summary: ASUR filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of its acquisition of Motiva's entire equity interest in CPC, adding 20 airports across Brazil, Ecuador, Costa Rica, and Curaçao. The purchase price was R$5.1 billion (US$992.2 million), subject to customary closing adjustments. The transaction, originally agreed November 18, 2025, was financed through a loan facility arranged at offer submission. All conditions precedent were satisfied. This deal expands ASUR's portfolio to 36 airports across the Americas. Watch for integration risk and regulatory performance of newly acquired concessions.
